body:
Fictional Financial Standards Board (FFSB) has published notice FFSB-SN-2026-897 (Retention of audit logs). It takes effect on 2026-11-07.

We need to know which systems this applies to and whether their audit-log retention is sufficient.
signature:
Owen Kerrigan
Head of Function, Compliance
Harbourline Mutual Finance Ltd
subject: Audit log retention requirement
